title: Silver Price Comparison: Spot vs. Retail (August 7, 2026)
takeaway: The difference between spot and retail silver prices can be significant.

data.label: Spot Price (August 7, 2026)
data.evidence: As of August 7, 2026, the spot price is $23.85 per ounce.

data.label: Retail Price Range (August 7, 2026)
data.evidence: Retail prices typically range from $24 to $26 per ounce, depending on the dealer and the form of silver (coins, bars, etc.).

narration: The article highlights a significant difference between the spot price of silver – currently $23.85 per ounce – and the retail price, which can range from $24 to $26 per ounce. This difference reflects the costs associated with distribution, fabrication, and dealer profit margins.
